en.headline: Customs seizes HK$4.6 million in illicit cigarettes and counterfeits in Sha Tau Kok
en.dek: Officers arrested a 50-year-old saleswoman after raiding a Chung Ying Street shop and finding about 720,000 suspected duty-not-paid cigarettes plus counterfeit goods.
body: Hong Kong Customs seized about 720,000 suspected illicit cigarettes and about 2,700 suspected counterfeit items with a total estimated market value of about HK$4.6 million during a special operation in Chung Ying Street, Sha Tau Kok, on Wednesday.

The suspected illicit cigarettes have a duty value of about HK$2.4 million. A 50-year-old local female salesperson was arrested. The case remains under investigation and further arrests are not ruled out.

Customs said officers found a retail shop selling suspected illicit cigarettes and seized the items from the shop and three connected rooms, along with suspected counterfeit perfumes, beauty products, belts and handbags. The department will continue to step up patrols in the area.

zh.headline: 海關沙頭角檢獲約460萬元私煙及冒牌貨 拘捕一名女子
zh.dek: 海關周三在中英街一間零售店檢獲約72萬支懷疑私煙及約2700件懷疑冒牌物品，並拘捕一名50歲女售貨員。
body: 香港海關於周三在沙頭角中英街採取特別執法行動，檢獲約72萬支懷疑私煙及約2700件懷疑冒牌物品，估計市值共約460萬元。
懷疑私煙的應課稅值約為240萬元。行動中拘捕一名50歲本地女售貨員，案件仍在調查中，不排除有更多人被捕。
海關人員發現店舖售賣懷疑私煙後入內調查，在店內及其三個相連房間檢獲私煙，以及香水、美容產品、皮帶和手袋等懷疑冒牌物品。海關表示會繼續加強中英街巡查。
